name: Invisible Apartment Zero
source:
Teenage girl hacker stumbles upon a secret that changes her life forever.

This is a visual novel about the growing up of a girl from the suburbs who dreams of a life in the big city. It's also about a conspiracy, hacking, surveillance, but most importantly about friendship.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=30396]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
少女黑客偶然发现了一个永远改变她生活的秘密。

这是一部视觉小说，讲述了一个梦想在大城市生活的郊区女孩的成长故事。这也是关于阴谋、黑客、监视的故事，但最重要的是关于友谊。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=30396]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
